endpoints.title: API manifest
endpoints.description: Self-describing manifest of every API endpoint: title, description, schema URL, updated timestamp, record counts, stability, and deprecation notes. Start here.

endpoints.title: Full activity library
endpoints.description: Every activity record: filters (age, time, group, location, materials, no_prep), setup, steps, variations, safety, optional season/occasion tags, optional source URL.

endpoints.title: Category definitions
endpoints.description: The 11 categories: id, name, blurb, color, glyph.

endpoints.title: Filter configuration
endpoints.description: Machine-readable filter configuration — the same matching logic the browser UI uses (range, select, multiselect, boolean, text search across name/tagline/materials/steps).

endpoints.title: Skills registry
endpoints.description: Registry of the reusable skill recipes in skills/: id, description, and file path.

endpoints.title: RSS review queue
endpoints.description: RSS-pipeline working queue: accepted / rejected / deferred activity candidates under review, with decisions and source links.
endpoints.notes: Not a stable public API — statuses and shape change as the pipeline runs. Treat undated numbers as stale.

deprecation_notes: No endpoints are deprecated as of 1.0.0. Breaking changes get a new v2/ path, never a silent shape change.
